results.name: Minimal linework
results.style: Precise flat editorial illustration, delicate taupe circle outlines, solid matte speech bubble, clean simple geometry.

request.prompt: A seamless looping animated GIF for a philosophy presentation, landscape composition. Exactly ONE small speech bubble with the unchanged black glyphs “文 A” represents a sentence. It moves from the center of a large fixed circle on the left to a large fixed circle on the right and back. Its fill changes from terracotta in the left context to teal in the right context. Keep the glyphs and bubble shape unchanged. Never show two copies of the sentence. The two circles represent contexts and remain stationary. No title, no captions, no additional text. Generous negative space and warm off-white #faf9f6 background. Fixed camera, clear movement, readable at small scale, first and last poses align for a loop. Style: Precise flat editorial illustration, delicate taupe circle outlines, solid matte speech bubble, clean simple geometry.
